title: Central and Southern Europe CCS & CDR Conference: Building on Hungary's strengths to create a regional carbon management hub
summary: One-day conference in Budapest on 11 February 2027, organised by Danube Carbon Storage, CSFK and Carbon Management Europe, with an optional site visit to the Danube Removals project on 12 February. Topics include EU policy and funding, subsurface monitoring, the business case for CCS, carbon removals and a roundtable on a Central European hub concept.
why_it_matters: Discussion of the regional hub concept for an inland, non-North-Sea region offers a comparison for hub-and-cluster design questions in Nordic-Baltic network planning.
